name: TDD batch implementation gated on a captured RED proof
description: Blueprint 41 of 96 (BP-IMP-04). FLAGSHIP. Defects are fixed in file-disjoint batches, and each batch must produce a RED PROOF ARTIFACT - the test runner's actual failing output at the pre-fix state - before any implementation is allowed. The distinctive mechanism is that the red capture is a stored, schema-valid receipt rather than an assertion that the test failed, which is what makes 'the test passes' unfakeable: a test that was already green before the fix is, by definition, not a regression test for this defect, and the batch is reclassified rather than silently fixed. Executed at 24-batch scale.

defect_list.description: Verified defects. A defect that cannot be expressed as a test is declared, not faked.

batch_size.description: Defects per batch. Batches must be file-disjoint or the concurrent commits collide.

mutation_check.description: S3b: coverage says a line RAN; mutation says a test would NOTICE if it broke

red_proof_store.description: Where the captured failing output lands. This directory IS the evidence base for every later 'fixed' claim.

test-author.description: Writes the failing test and captures the runner's REAL output; may not touch production code in this phase

fixer.description: Implements the narrowest change that turns the captured RED into GREEN; may not edit the test to make it pass

proof-reviewer.description: Adversarially reviews BOTH proofs - that the red output is genuine runner output at the pre-fix state, and that the green output is not a weakened test

owner.description: Rules on a defect that cannot produce a red proof

routes.reason: the proof reviewer must not share a vendor with the author of the proof it is auditing

red-proof-captured.expression: red_capture_present == true AND red_capture_is_runner_output == true AND test_was_green_before_fix == false

green-proof-captured.expression: green_capture_present == true AND test_body_unchanged_since_red == true AND assertions_removed == 0

stages.title: S0 GROUP defects into file-disjoint batches
Overlapping batches produce colliding concurrent commits

body.title: S1 WRITE the failing test and CAPTURE the runner's real red output

work_unit.title: Reproduce every defect in the batch as a FAILING test and store the runner's output as the red proof
work_unit.question_or_target: For each defect in the batch, write a test that fails at the CURRENT (pre-fix) commit, run it, and store the runner's verbatim failing output - exit code, node id, assertion text - as a schema-valid red-proof receipt. If the test passes before the fix, do NOT weaken it into failing: stop and mark the defect for reclassification.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: writing a test that fails for the RIGHT reason is the judgement-heavy step

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verbatim test-runner output including the non-zero exit status and the failing node id, captured at the pre-fix commit sha which is recorded alongside it - an assertion that the test failed is NOT accepted in place of the output
tests_required: the captured red output must contain a non-zero exit status and at least one failing node id
both-states control: running the SAME test at the post-fix commit must produce a green capture; a test that reads red at both commits is testing the wrong thing
a defect whose obvious test is already green pre-fix must be routed to reclassification, never fixed silently
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: a cross-vendor reviewer who re-runs the stored command at the recorded pre-fix sha and reproduces the failure independently
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WFA-0086 emitted only when red-receipt.json exists, parses against output_schema, carries verbatim runner output with a non-zero exit status, and records the pre-fix commit sha; otherwise FAILED:WFA-0086 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on this step - a second attempt to make a passing test fail is how a fake red proof gets written; escalate to reclassification instead

body.title: No implementation until the RED proof exists and is genuine
S2 IMPLEMENT - the narrowest change that turns RED into GREEN
S3 CAPTURE the green output with the test body byte-unchanged since the red run
A green reached by deleting assertions is not a fix
S3b OPTIONAL - revert the fix hunk and require the failure to return
A surviving mutant on a changed line is recorded, not swallowed
S4 ADVERSARIAL REVIEW of the red AND the green capture
S5 COMMIT - hooks always run, the receipts travel with the commit

stages.title: A defect with no obtainable red proof is reclassified in writing, never silently fixed
stages.prompt: These defects could not produce a red proof: the test was already green pre-fix, the failure is not reproducible, or the behaviour resists expression as a test. Reclassify each - not-reproducible, test-was-wrong, or genuinely-untestable-and-disclosed.

stages.title: Standing audit: every 'fixed' defect in this run must have a stored red proof

impact.blast_radius: one commit per batch plus the red/green receipts; reverting a batch reverts its fix and its test together

worked_example.scenario: Batch B07 carries two defects: D1 'shredFile leaves a partial file on ENOSPC' and D2 'the settings loader ignores a per-project override'.
worked_example.step_1_red: test_shred_enospc fails at pre-fix sha 4c1e9ab with `E  AssertionError: expected 0 residual bytes, got 4096` and exit status 1 -> red-receipt.json stores that verbatim text plus the sha
worked_example.step_1_red_D2: test_project_override PASSES at the same sha - so it is not a regression test for D2. red-gate fails on test_was_green_before_fix == true and D2 goes to reclassify-untestable, where it is recorded as test-was-wrong (the real defect was in the resolver, not the loader)
worked_example.step_2_green: after the fix, the same test body (byte-unchanged, verified) exits 0 -> green-receipt.json
worked_example.step_3_mutation: reverting only the fix hunk must bring the failure back. It does for D1. On a sibling batch B11 the mutant SURVIVES - mutation-gate records surviving_mutants == 1 and the batch is flagged rather than silently blessed
worked_example.audit: red-proof-audit then asserts fixed_defects_without_red_proof == 0 across the whole run - the check that would have caught a batch fixed with no stored proof

x_extensions.distinctive_mechanism: the red capture is a STORED, schema-valid receipt of the runner's real output at a recorded pre-fix sha, and the write-failing-test stage is explicitly no-retry so a second attempt cannot manufacture one
contraindications: NOT for exploratory spikes - there is no defect to prove
NOT where the failure genuinely cannot be expressed as a test - say so via reclassification instead of faking a red
NOT a substitute for the standalone red-proof certification gate that audits somebody ELSE's work
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-TST-06 CERTIFIES a red proof that already exists, over work this workflow did not do; this is the implementation loop that PRODUCES one, and its no-retry write step is the anti-faking control.
